verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no claim about how fast new open-weight models appear in the hosted Model APIs catalog; it only says Model APIs serve 'supported' models. An ml-engineer can still self-deploy a newly released Hugging Face model through Truss: a config.yaml plus `truss push`, using engines like vLLM, SGLang or TensorRT-LLM. That path covers 'supported architectures', so very new architectures may need a custom Python Model class. Missing for 10: any documented day-zero or fast-follow release policy, examples of new models added to Model APIs shortly after release, and independent reports on time-to-availability.
